clips.intro: Welcome to the Unit Three and Unit Six English test. Listen carefully. Enjoy your journey through nature and around the world.
clips.l2: Girl: Shall we visit the desert on Saturday? Father: It will be too hot. Let us go to the waterfall instead. Girl: What about the lake? Father: We can go there on Sunday.
clips.l4: Boy: Is this town famous for its old buildings? Girl: No. People come here for its local food. The food festival is very popular.
clips.l5: Lucy: I cannot find my passport! Father: Is your flight ticket missing too? Lucy: No, the ticket is on my phone. Father: Does your flight leave at eight thirty? Lucy: That was the old time. It now leaves at nine thirty in the morning.
clips.l6: Welcome to Blue Lake. We saw eighteen birds on our walk. The lake is eighty metres deep at its deepest point. It is three kilometres wide.
clips.l7: Girl: Ben, why did you travel abroad last month? Ben: I wanted to learn about another culture. Girl: What did you do there? Ben: I tried local food, visited a waterfall and talked to local people.
